name: MUHIBAH
recent: Muhibbah Engineering 在2026年10月至11月期间持续进行股份回购，并有一笔ESOS新股发行。公司公布了截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩，新闻显示季度净利为655万令吉。
notable: 公司持续进行股份回购，10月至11月期间多次在公开市场买回股份。
公司通过ESOS计划发行40,000股新股，发行价为每股RM0.38，并于2026年11月13日上市。
公司公布截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩，新闻显示季度净利为655万令吉。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的季度，营收为3.814亿令吉，环比增长63.2%，同比增长16.5%；净利为1,677万令吉，环比增长30.2%，但同比下降32.3%；净利率为4.4%，低于上一季度的5.5%。

news.title: Muhibbah Engineering (M) Reports Quarterly Profit Attributable 6.55 Million RGT

events.what: 下一季 (9 月底结束) 季报最迟公布日 · 交易所规定
events.what_en: Deadline for the quarter ending Sep (Bursa rule)

recent_en: Muhibbah Engineering conducted continuous share buybacks from October to November 2026 and issued new ESOS shares. The company announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with news reporting a quarterly profit attributable of RM6.55 million.
notable_en: The company conducted continuous share buybacks, repurchasing shares in the open market multiple times from October to November.
The company issued 40,000 new shares under its ESOS at an issue price of RM0.38 per share, listed on 13 November 2026.
The company announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with news reporting a quarterly profit of RM6.55 million.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM381.4 million, up 63.2% QoQ and 16.5% YoY; net income was RM16.77 million, up 30.2% QoQ but down 32.3% YoY; net margin was 4.4%, lower than 5.5% in the previous quarter.
